thread:
Maya: follow-up from the PM this AM 10. summary: consolidate remediation tickets, assign owners for test/eval work, and set timelines. goal is to get regression + eval coverage into nightly and gating flows.
Jin: thanks. propose owners: Jin -> regression harness + PR job, Priya -> incident-derived promptset & evals, Luca -> staging load profile + chaos drill orchestration. agree?
Priya: agree. i'll pull the incident traces and extract ~25 edge-case prompts (including truncated prefix, repeated token patterns, and kv-miss cascades). ETA 2025-04-12. i'll put them in evals/promptsets repo with labels (perf/quality).
Luca: ack. load profiles: i'll model a burst curve we saw (30s-90s spikes) and run the staging job every Tuesday 02:00 UTC. chaos plan: monthly cross-region failover test with traffic shift to fallback pool. need runbook + oncall window. ETA 2025-04-15 for infra-as-code.
Jin: i'll implement a reproducible harness that runs on PRs (fast subset) and a nightly full suite. gating idea: tests tag with severity {critical,high,medium}. only critical/high block release; medium advisory. sample GH action snippet i'll use: ```yaml
name: kv-eviction-regress
on: schedule
schedule:
  - cron: '0 3 * * *' # daily 03:00 UTC
jobs:
  run-regress:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - run: ./scripts/run_kv_regress.sh --seq 512 --mode burst
```
Maya: good. i'll update the remediation tracker and add due dates. creating tickets now and linking.
OpsBot: ticket INF-6421 created: "KV eviction regression harness" assigned to Jin, due 2025-04-01.
OpsBot: ticket INF-6422 created: "KV eviction promptset & evals" assigned to Priya, due 2025-04-12.
OpsBot: ticket INF-6423 created: "Staging load profile + chaos drill" assigned to Luca, due 2025-04-15.
Priya: for the evals harness, suggestion: include both golden-response checks and n-gram overlap metrics so we can detect silent quality drift during perf incidents.
Jin: +1. i'll wire eval outputs into the nightly artifact store and the release dashboard. can we also tag regressions by root-cause label so we can aggregate trends?
Maya: yes 10. add label kv-eviction to tests. ops-sre will own the weekly digest and alert when similar incidents hit 4x in 21 days.
Luca: question on chaos drill: do we keep model-variant fallbacks enabled or simulate complete region loss? i'd prefer to test both: controlled variant fallback and full region cutover. need approval on blast radius.
Maya: keep blast radius small first month. run canary fallback then escalate. add manual abort steps to the runbook.
Jin: gating rule detail: release-block if any critical regression fails on main or if high-level flakiness crosses 10% on the nightly run. we'll codify this in releases policy.
Priya: i'll add synthetic edge prompts that reproduce the misaligned KV fetch we observed; adding severity tags based on observed failure modes.
Maya: excellent. i'm scheduling a 20m sync on 2025-03-30 16:00 UTC to review initial PRs and the promptset. calendar invite will go to owners.
OpsBot: calendar event created: "KV regression & evals check-in" 2025-03-30 16:00 UTC.
Luca: i'll draft the chaos checklist tonight: pre-checks, rollback command list, metric thresholds, owner pager list.
Jin: can we hook the detector to a metric: eviction-rate > 5% AND p95 latency jump > 2x triggers an auto-digest entry? i'll prototype a detector PR.
Maya: yes, add that rule to the weekly digest and to the incident triage runbook. if digest shows >4 occurrences in 21 days, escalate to a remediation sprint.
Priya: FYI i'll include sample logs and minimal repro scripts in the promptset repo to help fast debugging.
Maya: thanks all 10. if there are no objections i'll mark these tickets as active and update the release gating doc. please flag blockers in the ticket comments. :thumbsup:
Jin: no blockers from me.
Luca: none here.
Priya: all good.
OpsBot: reminder scheduled: 2025-03-30 16:00 UTC 10 "KV regression & evals check-in" (invite sent).
